check = briefs %>%
  filter(brief == "air_quality") %>%
  mutate(
    compute = "client", refresh_min = 60, grain = "aggregate", rls = FALSE,
    rows_sent = if_else(compute == "client", rows_window, groups),
    rows_scanned = if_else(compute == "matview", groups, rows_window),
    payload_kb = rows_sent * bytes_per_row / 1024,
    latency_ms = 80 + rows_scanned / 500,
    stale_min = if_else(compute == "matview", pmax(refresh_min, cadence_min), cadence_min),
    cron_usd = if_else(compute == "matview", 43200 / refresh_min * rows_window * 3e-7, 0),
    api_usd = if_else(compute == "endpoint", requests_month * rows_window * 5e-10, 0),
    egress_usd = requests_month * payload_kb / 1024^2 * 0.09,
    cost_usd = 25 + cron_usd + api_usd + egress_usd,
    pass_fresh = stale_min + latency_ms / 60000 <= max_stale_min,
    pass_payload = payload_kb <= max_payload_kb,
    pass_privacy = grain == "aggregate" | rls,
    pass_cost = cost_usd <= budget_usd
  )

check %>%
  select(payload_kb, latency_ms, stale_min, cost_usd,
         pass_fresh, pass_payload, pass_privacy, pass_cost)
